web.title: Chaos magick: Doing what works and more
web.description:
In the context of the essay, Farrell is snidely suggesting that [chaos magicians](https://www.spiralnature.com/topic/chaos-magick/) practice [magick](https://www.spiralnature.com/topic/magick/) with no understanding or interest in the theory behind it, [1](https://www.spiralnature.com/magick/chaos-magick-doing-what-works-more/#footnote_0_2917) cheerily believing that as long as you want “it,” “it” will happen.

[Peter Carroll](https://www.spiralnature.com/topic/peter-carroll/)‘s [_Liber Null & Psychonaut_](http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/0877286396/ref=as_li_qf_sp_asin_il_tl?ie=UTF8&camp=1789&creative=9325&creativeASIN=0877286396&linkCode=as2&tag=spiralnature-20) details strenuous exercises to hone the will and expand the magician’s skillset, [3](https://www.spiralnature.com/magick/chaos-magick-doing-what-works-more/#footnote_2_2917) and [_Liber Kaos_](http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/0877287422/ref=as_li_qf_sp_asin_il_tl?ie=UTF8&camp=1789&creative=9325&creativeASIN=0877287422&linkCode=as2&tag=spiralnature-20) lays out a 21-stage training program to further develop various techniques.

1. For now I’ll leave it to the [Thelemites](https://www.spiralnature.com/topic/thelema-2/) to challenge the sidelong insult aimed at them. [ [↩](https://www.spiralnature.com/magick/chaos-magick-doing-what-works-more/#identifier_0_2917)]
